TIKTOK SAFE AREA

Every slide keeps its content inside 192px from the top, 384px from the bottom and 196px from the right — clear of the tab bar, the caption block and the action rail. The photos still bleed to the edges; only text is constrained.

safecheck-*.png in the repo show the slides with those zones overlaid.

SLIDE 5 SOURCES

Baltimore: Christopher Sharp, filmed an arrest at the 2010 Preakness; police deleted every video on his phone; city paid $250,000 in 2014; DOJ statement of interest 2012.

Des Moines: Daniel Robbins, May 2018; phone and camera seized without a warrant, held twelve days; $125,000 settled 2022 after the Eighth Circuit reversed.

Philadelphia 2021 is an allegation in a lawsuit and is worded as one on the slide.
